verdict.rationale: First-party docs say facets are filters that also return distribution data. They describe e-commerce navigation by brand, color, size and price range with counts per option (e.g. "Color: Red (12), Blue (8)"), plus a facet-search endpoint and React InstantSearch pairing for building filter UIs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that counts for multiple facets come back in one search request, documentation of range/numeric facet statistics beyond a marketing mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of faceting in practice.
